assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Redesign this nightclub building sprite for Total City Grind. Preserve square 2x2 tile footprint and STRICT 90-degree overhead orthographic camera, top surfaces only, no visible vertical facades, no perspective or isometric angle. Match the reference's illustrated game texture and clear outlines. Replace all pitched roof sections with ONE completely FLAT dark charcoal roof. The main feature is a very large clean rectangular blank black LED screen flush into the roof, taking up about 70 percent of the square, with subtle fine pixel texture and NO TEXT. Roof border has slim segmented neon-light fixtures, currently OFF, suitable for a runtime chasing-light animation. Keep small ventilation details confined to narrow outer corners, uncluttered screen. Neat premium nightclub design, dark graphite with subtle burgundy accents. No people, cars, parking, roads, logos, words, lit neon glow, or baked-in signs. Entire building visible with minimal transparent margin and genuinely transparent background. This is the unlit daytime base asset; all screen text and illumination will be drawn later in code.
